Run Your Private School
From One Dashboard

Klasso is the multi-tenant school OS built for primary and secondary private schools in Nigeria. Manage exams (CBT), competency grades, report cards, class notes, and fee payments in one peaceful dashboard.

School Admin Stress

Running a school is complex.

Every proprietor we spoke to said the same thing — too many tools, too little time.

Admin Overhead

Managing attendance, schedules, and curriculum documents across disjointed spreadsheets and WhatsApp groups consumes hours daily.

Report Card Delays

Manually calculating grades, CBT scores, and teachers' remarks takes weeks of stressful work at the end of every school term.

Fee Collection Gaps

Tracking school fees, handling payment plans, and writing paper receipts leads to bookkeeping errors and cash flow delays.

Our Mission

Making premium school management accessible to every school.

Klasso was born from a simple realization: private schools are bogged down by administrative complexity, leaving proprietors stressed and teachers overworked.

We are building a secure, multi-tenant portal that isolates and streamlines operations for each school — enabling proprietors, staff, and parents to collaborate with ease.

"We wanted to build something that feels like a calm harbor for school management, serving proprietors first."

How It Works

Go from scattered paper records and WhatsApp messages to a unified school portal in three simple steps.

1

Register Your School Portal

Create an isolated tenant dashboard under the klasso.app domain for your institution.

2

Invite Staff & Define Structure

Easily set up your school classes, subjects, fee schedules, and invite teachers and parents.

3

Run Everything Calmly

Manage CBT exams, auto-generate report cards, and collect fee payments via Paystack.

Exam Integrity & Proctoring

Secure Anti-Cheat Computer-Based Testing.

Klasso CBT is engineered to run high-stakes terminal exams and continuous assessments with total academic integrity, even on low-spec hardware or shared tablets.

Tab-Switch & Focus Tracking

Detects when students attempt to switch browser tabs, open external applications, or look up answers, logging instant violations.

Server-Side Timers & Auto-Submit

Guarantees timed assessments submit strictly when the clock runs out, blocking local system clock manipulation.
